(561)༄༅/ /shangs lugs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (561)༄༅// shangs lugs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

(562)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la// btu da nas sngags rigs thams cad kyis// legs par sgrub la nyer mkho ba'i// sgrub thabs cung zad tsam zhig bri/ /bdag nyid sngags gi yi dam yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed gnas pas/ /rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor dang*// chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su gzhal med khang dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su padma'i gdan lnga tshom/ dbus su zla ba la oṃ las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ zhi ba'i nyams ldan/ shar du nyi ma la hūm̐ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ khro bo'i nyams ldan/ lho ru zla ba ser po la trāṃ las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu rgyan can/ dgyes pa'i nyams ldan/ nub tu nyi ma dmar mo zer dang bral ba la hrīḥlas padma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can// chags pa'i nyams ldan/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje (563)la āḥlas sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu don grub kyi dbu rgyan can khro zhing bzhed pa sogs nyams sna tshogs pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas cang te'u 'khrol zhing*// g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs dkar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa ldang cu'i do shal rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang bcas pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings su gnas pa// mchan khung g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭwāṃ ga la rim pa bzhin du 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che padma ral gri rnams kyi mtshan pa/ 'od zer sna lda 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ rang mtshungs kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo 'bum 'bum dang 'khor mkha' 'gro grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba'o// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/

rang bzhin gyi gnas dang phyogs mtshams thams cad nas gtso mo ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs (564)med pas bskor ba badzra sa mā dza/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas g.yab cing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra ā ka dha ya/ ā ka ḍha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ bandha ya/ bandha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ sarba ḍā ki nāṃ/ hri da yaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan lnga/ arghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥ.oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī aḥhrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki ni āḥhrī trāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥ.āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ spyi dril gyi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ swā āḥhā hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa rnams bzlas par bya'o// mchod gtor bdag bskyed dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ phud kyi dang po'i gtor ma/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis phul/ de nas mkha' 'gro la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ trāṃ phaḍaḥ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥphaḍaḥ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tī tstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hoḥphaṭa/ ces lan gsum sogs kyi phul/ rgyas par na tshig bcad dang bcas pa dang*/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// nas sangs rgyas rigs su skye/

/zhes pa'i bar brjod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ bdag bsrung smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o// gong gis gtor chog de nyid kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul ba dang*/ lnga tshan lnga ba'i gtor ma thun bzhir 'bul ba gtor ma brgya pa dang*/ bzhi tshan bcu drug cu 'bul ba dbyug gu'i gtor ma ste/ rgyas pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ dbang dug gi las la bsngags so// de dag gi lag len (565) dang*/ las byang gzhan du shes par bya'o// 'di'i gtor dbang ni/ chos 'byung gi dbus su tshom bu lnga bkod/ de'i steng du gtor ma lnga la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gzugs sam/ sngags byang 'dzugs/ stegs bu mtho ba zhig la phud gtor chung ba zhig bsham/ mchod pa rnams ci bder bsgrigs nas gong bzhin bdag mdun bzlas pa/ gtor 'bul 'dod gsol kyi bar byas nas/ slob ma la chab btang*/ maṇḍal bkye bsdu/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ de'ang lam zab mo gsang sngags kyi theg pa 'dir rgyud sde bzhir bzhugs pa'i nang nas rgyud sde gong ma mchog tu gyur pa rnal 'byor bla med/ de la thabs shes kyis phye ba'am pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su dbye ba'i/ rnal 'byor pha ma gnyis mthar thug dgongs pa gcig kyang*// dngos bstan ston tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ pha rgyud kyi khyad chos zab gnad thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la tshang zhing*/ pha rgyud du mi gsal ba'i zab gnad mang po yang ma rgyud la lhag por yod pas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud nyid mchog tu zab cing myur ba yin/ des na rnal 'byor ma rgyud la/ rnal 'byor ma'i thabs dang dngos grub gtso bor ston pa'i phyir/ dngos grub ni rdo rje pho nya mo rnams kyi gtso bor stsol ba'i phyir gang zhig sgrub pa po sngags lam zab mor 'jug pa rnams kyis ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams rtag tu mnyes ba'i thabs la 'bad pa gal che'o// de ltar 'bad pas ni rigs sngags myur du 'grub pa dang*/

nyams chags skong zhing*// las bzhi'i dngos grub sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mchog 'grub pa gdon mi za bas/ 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po khyung po lo tstsha ba'i man ngag las byung ba ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bka' gtad gtor dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul gzhug /thal mo me tog dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid (566)pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ /ces lan gsum/ rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa 'di'i rjes zlos// bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /sogs lan gsum/ de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar sgoms shig /khyod rang rnams kyi snying ga'i nang du padma'i gdan lnga tshom sogs mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ ye shes bkug cing bstim/ mchod bstod kyi bar song nas/ gtor ma kha gsos byin rlabs byas la gtor chog bsngo/ 'dod don gsol ba btab par bya/ de nas gtor ma thogs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med pas bskor ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon/ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa stan thog 'di nyid du stsol bar mos shing*/ bcom ldan 'das ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor nas rim par byon pa'i rtsa ba dang rgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med pa khyed rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas dbang bskur ba dang byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs ye shes thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ rlung sems snang ba thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dgra gdon bgegs tshogs thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol// mdor na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don re ba thams cad yid (567)bzhin tu 'grub pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs cing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung pa'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /zhes dang gong gi sngags rnams brjod la gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag /rjes dam tshig khas blang*/ gtong rag maṇḍal/ lus 'bul dge bsngo rnams bya// mdun bskyed mchod pa kha gsos la mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab nongs bshags bzod gsol/ rten yod na ye shes pa brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ rten med na lha gshegs/ dge bsngo shis brjod rgyas par spel lo// kun nas nyams chags bskang ba dang*// las sgrub gang la'ang shis shing dga'// sgrub bo kun la mkho ba 'di// snying nas brtse bas myur por bris// mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// zhes sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas khol du byungs te rjes gnang bklags chog tu bkod pa dge legs 'phel// (568)
